Game Overview

In Zombie World, the core idea is straightforward: face relentless waves of zombies in Zombie World, a thrilling first-person shooter where your survival skills are put to the ultimate test. Strategically manage your limited ammo, utilize power-ups, and outmaneuver hordes to stay alive in this pulse-pounding post-apocalyptic adventure. How long can you withstand the undead?
